description:
Young Taoist Cheong Pung Faces a Thousand-Year Curse!

Follow the story of a young Taoist, Cheong Pung, gifted with the ability to see spirits, and the founder of the Wudang Sect, Zhang Sanfeng, drawn in by Cheong Pung's spiritual power while on his way to attend a gathering of immortals.

As Cheong Pung joins the Wudang Sect, he finds himself constantly battling spirits from the netherworld and starving ghouls.
Behind it all lies the thousand-year-old grudge of a demon, the former ruler of Wudang Mountain, Yogu Myeon-Yang, whom Zhang Sanfeng had banished long ago!

A new saga in the world of Murim where Taoist magic, sorcery, curses, and dark arts run rampant.
The epic clash between Zhang Sanfeng and Myeon-Yang from a millennium ago is about to reignite once again!
